decisions.rationale: The complete other-person expression is someone else, the person receiving the blow. Full PHA ROL PO attests another/other person; exclude to.
The certain-death qualification is sure, directly attested. The source die and English causative kill are recast; no isolated chi/kill claim is made.
The striking predicate is realized in the English light-verb expression as blow; full BSNUN explicitly attests blow. The separate raw mtshan is not silently converted to weapon.
Exact complete killer compound has HGM murderer. It owns the first murderer, not the final anaphoric repetition.
The demonstrative following killer owns this before murderer. Emphatic himself is supplied and is not added to de.
Exact victim compound belongs to the first comparison. His remains outside.
Whole temporal adverb before is directly attested; no torn final r.
The source alternative coordinator links the two premature-death timings and owns this or, not the later question disjunction.
Complete temporal adverb is rendered twice as together and at the same time. Bank its first explicit rendering once; the explanatory repetition remains unwrapped, not another source word.
La marks the person about whom actual commission is asked, rendered for. Expanded such a murderer is not treated as another gsod byed occurrence.
Whole technical term directly attests path of action. Full and a are supplied; no speculative member is added without separately captured member evidence.
Genitive gyi relates actual commission to the path of action, giving the of after stage. The of inside path of action belongs to that technical compound.
Complete technical actual-stage term, with GMR's quoted commission gloss and stage noun. Full entry attests main stage/actual commission; do not isolate guessed component meanings.
The positive occurrence predicate is occurred. Perfect support has stays outside; negative question repeats the predicate elliptically and receives no second occurrence pairing.
Whole question-disjunction particle owns the final or, directly attested. Do not split its final m.
Explicit lexical negative is not. The following source occurrence verb is elided after English not, not an invented second occurred or false content-absence null.
